honest_c3: C1 — top-level CLI 'anima' vs naming-convention reference 'anima-core' creates surface tension; spec §5.1 paradigm doc uses `anima-core dialogue` form but actual integrated dispatch is `anima dialogue` (top-level verb). Recommend spec doc update to align with top-level form.

C2 — dispatcher resolution depends on /Users/ghost/.hx/bin/anima shim staying intact (currently 284-byte exec passthrough). If shim is replaced or PATH order changes, top-level dispatch breaks silently.

C3 — V3 probe runs in synthetic_fallback mode because torch/transformers AutoModelForCausalLM import fails in mac-local hexa runtime. Real-CLM-v4 activation is a separate concern (HF cache + venv repair) — top-level dispatch correctness is independent.

C4 — HEXA_LOCAL=1 env prefix is mandatory for all dialogue invocations on mac (top-level OR direct wrapper); without it hexa-resolver routes to ubu1 remote where mac /opt/homebrew/bin/python3 path doesn't exist (V3 lesson). User-facing manual must always include this prefix or document HEXA_LOCAL=1 default in shell rc.

C5 — selftest verdict equivalence between top-level dispatch (dialogue.hexa sub_selftest) and direct wrapper (bash selftest()) is structural — they probe the same 4 artifacts but emit slightly different field labels (dialogue.hexa: `bash_wrapper`, bash: `mount_hexa`). Output text is not byte-identical even though semantics align.
